title: DB connection pool exhaustion — 2025-11-03
description: HikariPool max connections reached. API returned 503. Long-running queries blocked connections.
resolution: Increased pool size to 50, added 10s query timeout, killed blocking queries.

title: OOM crash — worker nodes — 2025-09-14
description: Worker pods killed with OOMKilled. Heap usage climbed to 100% during bulk ETL job.
resolution: Increased JVM -Xmx to 4G, paginated ETL job, set K8s memory limit to 5Gi.

title: Payment service timeout cascade — 2025-08-22
description: Downstream payment provider elevated latency. Circuit breaker opened. Checkout success rate dropped.
resolution: Enabled fallback payment processor, tuned circuit breaker thresholds, added retry with jitter.

title: K8s CrashLoopBackOff — missing env var — 2025-07-10
description: Deployment without required DATABASE_URL env var. All pods exited code 1 on startup.
resolution: Added env var to K8s secret, re-deployed. Added startup validation to catch missing config.

title: Redis cache eviction storm — 2025-06-05
description: Redis maxmemory reached. allkeys-lru eviction kicked in. Cache hit rate dropped from 95% to 12%, DB overloaded.
resolution: Increased Redis memory to 8GB, switched to volatile-lru policy, added cache warming on startup.

title: Elasticsearch disk I/O saturation — 2025-05-18
description: ES nodes hit disk I/O saturation during large index operation. Search latency spiked 10x.
resolution: Throttled bulk indexing, increased refresh_interval to 30s, migrated to SSD-backed nodes.
